result.title: Macro Control and Capability Evaluation of Black-Box World Models: A Two-Regime Framework for LLM-Agent Markets
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can be organized into multi-agent markets that act as world models, mapping macro information to emergent macro dynamics while the evaluator observes only macro inputs and outputs. This paper separates a model's capability into two stages that a single aggregate score cannot separate: information simulation, from macro information to micro behavior, and macro emergence, from micro behavior to the macro outcome. We introduce a soft macro-control method that announces a public reference path day by day without touching individual decisions, orders, or matching, and a two-regime evaluation framework that measures both stages from macro observations alone. In the reference-only regime the symmetric true and flipped references share a common level R, which measures realization under the announced reference, while their paired gap B measures structural bias; in the information-injection regime external information dilutes the reference, so only the true-flipped gap Delta remains interpretable. On five single-index LLM-agent markets, announcing a target path shifts the realized path toward the announced target on both announced references under both information conditions. Relative to the no-reference path, the tracking score is higher by 0.306 and 0.415 without news and by 0.183 and 0.329 with news; within the stock/cash scan structural bias is lowest at 70/30 (B=0.042); realization peaks at a 3:7 technical share (R=0.894 versus 0.358 for technical-only); and Delta is 0.0341 with fundamental data and 0.0487 with news. Both stages use the same two observable scores, each read in the regime where it is interpretable.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文把 LLM 多智能体市场视为世界模型，提出只逐日公布参考路径而不干预个体决策的「软宏观控制」方法，并设计两阶段（宏观信息到微观行为、微观行为到宏观结果）评价框架，在五个单指数市场上验证追踪效果与结构性偏差。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉/多模态推理主线无直接关联，但其「只凭宏观可观测输入输出、用外部参考做弱干预来分离两阶段能力」的思路，可能为判断 latent 内容是否真正被下游使用、区分内部模拟与涌现结果提供评价类比，可供核查。
